verdicts.title: Structure and Problem Hardness: Goal Asymmetry and DPLL Proofs in<br> SAT-Based Planning

verdicts.title: Hankel Determinants of convoluted Catalan numbers and nonintersecting lattice paths: A bijective proof of Cigler's Conjecture
